headline: Lightning strike causes fire at Power Minister Tuku's home in Sirajganj
summary: The blaze broke out at a gas riser near the gate of the Minister's residence on Wednesday afternoon during a storm.
details: A fire broke out at the residence of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Iqbal Hasan Mahmud Tuku in Sirajganj following a lightning strike on Wednesday afternoon.
The incident occurred at the Minister's house on Al-Mahmud Avenue in the Hossainpur area of the city.
Local residents reported that several rounds of lightning strikes occurred during rain in Sirajganj, leading to a sudden fire at the gas riser located near the gate of the house.
The sudden appearance of flames caused panic among nearby residents, who immediately alerted the fire service.
Firefighters from the Sirajganj Fire Service arrived quickly at the scene and brought the blaze under control.
Authorities confirmed that there was no major damage to the house or the gas lines.
Following the event, necessary security measures have been taken to ensure the safety of the gas line in that specific area.

The sudden appearance of flames caused panic among nearby residents, who immediately alerted the fire service.

Firefighters from the Sirajganj Fire Service arrived quickly at the scene and brought the blaze under control.

topic: river erosion threatens homes in Dashmina
headline_marked: River erosion in Patuakhali: [[Residents relocate graves of loved ones]] as Tetulia River surges
headline: River erosion in Patuakhali: Residents relocate graves of loved ones as Tetulia River surges
summary: Severe riverbank erosion in Dashmina Upazila has destroyed roads and embankments, forcing locals to move furniture and graves to avoid loss.
details: Severe riverbank erosion of the Tetulia River in Patuakhali's Dashmina Upazila has caused widespread panic among local residents.
The erosion began on Tuesday night, September 8, around 9 PM, when a large section of the road near the Hazirhat launch ghat was swallowed by the river.
Terrified residents spent the night moving their furniture and essential belongings to safer locations to avoid losing everything.
By Wednesday morning, the risk to a local cemetery became so critical that residents were forced to dig up and relocate the bodies of their parents and relatives to other locations.
Students and locals held a human chain protest on Wednesday at 11:30 AM to demand immediate action for erosion prevention and the rehabilitation of victims.
Existing geo-bags and embankments provided by the Water Development Board (WDB) have already been washed away by the river's current.
There is growing concern that the Hazirhat Jamia Mosque, Hazirhat Market, and Hazirhat Secondary School may be next if effective measures are not taken immediately.
The Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) Md. Mahmud Hasan Mridha has stated that the administration is coordinating with WDB officials to take necessary measures to protect the road and embankment.
caption:
Residents in Patuakhali are forced to dig up and relocate the graves of their loved ones as the Tetulia River swallows their land.

Severe riverbank erosion of the Tetulia River in Patuakhali's Dashmina Upazila has caused widespread panic among local residents.

The erosion began on Tuesday night, September 8, around 9 PM, when a large section of the road near the Hazirhat launch ghat was swallowed by the river.

Terrified residents spent the night moving their furniture and essential belongings to safer locations to avoid losing everything.

By Wednesday morning, the risk to a local cemetery became so critical that residents were forced to dig up and relocate the bodies of their parents and relatives to other locations.

Students and locals held a human chain protest on Wednesday at 11:30 AM to demand immediate action for erosion prevention and the rehabilitation of victims.

Existing geo-bags and embankments provided by the Water Development Board (WDB) have already been washed away by the river's current.

There is growing concern that the Hazirhat Jamia Mosque, Hazirhat Market, and Hazirhat Secondary School may be next if effective measures are not taken immediately.

The Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) Md. Mahmud Hasan Mridha has stated that the administration is coordinating with WDB officials to take necessary measures to protect the road and embankment.
